metadata.processing_notes: Comprehensive knowledge graph extraction from 46 colony/territory files from the 1899 Colonial Office List. Extraction preserves historical spelling, terminology, and data as written in source documents. Due to the massive scale (26,530 lines across 46 files with thousands of entities), this extraction focuses on key entities from each colony: governors, major officials, principal institutions, geographic data, economic statistics, infrastructure, and demographics. Three files (WESTERN_AUSTRALIA, CAPE_OF_GOOD_HOPE, DOMINION_OF_CANADA) exceeded single-read limits and were processed in sections.
